title: jacobaea pseudoarnica
intro: Jacobaea pseudoarnica, commonly known as Wolf's Bane or Arnica, is a perennial herb belonging to the sunflower family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and pain, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Jacobaea pseudoarnica include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and analgesic properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe skin irritations and relieve joint pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
